title: Builder: six new role blocks so every theme gets Groups, First visit, Save a spot, Where we meet, Tools and Our story
detail:
Adds circles, firstvisit, booking, locations, business and story to lib/blocks/roles (role JSON, renderer in components/page-editor/blocks/roles.tsx, role CSS reading the core tokens only). Theme-agnostic: the same markup wears all ten site themes, so no theme edits its own block. Opt-in: nothing renders unless an owner adds one, so no live site changes. Live roles (circles, booking, locations) read the Space's rows or the owner's words; sample words are flagged sample:true. Done when: ROLES has 23 entries; each new role renders every variant with its sample on all ten themes at coverage 1.00 in check:theme-conformance; no raw colour in the new CSS. Audit: docs/design/frequency-builder-v3/v3-review-and-needs.md section 2.

Five new roles (firstvisit, booking, locations, business, story) plus a Photo-and-timetable layout on Chapters stand in for Groups; ten themes wear them through the core tokens. Rendered on Nocturne and Network at 390 and 1280. Not done: gatherings agenda (BLD-211). CORRECTION: the repo's Chapters role already covers Groups, so five roles are new (firstvisit, booking, locations, business, story) and Groups gets a timetable layout on Chapters.
